messages:
anna-devsec: FYI found a Docker registry auth token in a public gist (low traffic, probably from a stray CI env). token maps to svc-ci-build@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com. I’ve pinned the gist link in #incidents.
ben-ops: ack. which registries are affected? prod or just staging?
anna-devsec: prod and staging. token was used for image pulls from prod-registry.redwood.internal and staging-registry. It appears to be a long-lived SA key (JSON key) that was accidentally committed ages ago.
claire-sre: ok starting immediate containment. plan: 1) disable/delete the SA key, 2) remove creds from Buildkite/store, 3) rotate the Vault secret that holds registry credentials, 4) re-encrypt with fresh KMS key if needed. anyone object?
dave-plateng: no objections. need an RBAC check too — confirm there aren’t other tokens scoped to that SA used by other services. I can run a quick IAM bindings audit.
ben-ops: I’ll take SA key revocation. Steps I’ll run now:
```
# list keys
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=svc-ci-build@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-prod
# disable then delete
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=svc-ci-build@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-prod
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=svc-ci-build@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-prod
```
ben-ops: after delete, I’ll post the key ids I removed. tagging @claire-sre so you can proceed with node cleanup.
claire-sre: removing the credential from nodes and from Buildkite env now. also will rotate the secret in Vault at path `secret/data/registry/ci`. plan to reseal/unseal is fine.
anna-devsec: note — the Vault secret is encrypted with KMS key `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/registry-key`. we should rewrap the new secret to the same key or move to new key if we want to rotate KMS as well.
dave-plateng: I suggest a KMS rewrap to a new key version so we have a clean key history. audits-bot, can you export the access logs for that KMS key for the last 30 days?
audits-bot: export job started: export-kms-registry-1842004321. Expect CSV in GCS bucket gs://redwood-audits/exports/ within 20m.
anna-devsec: audit query I ran for suspicious SA key usage (useful for others):
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:svc-ci-build@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com AND resource.type=service_account_key" --limit 200 --project=redwood-prod
```
claire-sre: one caveat — the registry token is used by some legacy buildkite agents pinned in k8s DaemonSet. I’ll update the daemonset to use the new Vault path token and restart pods in a rolling way.
ben-ops: timeline proposal: prod SA key rotation = within 2 hours; Vault secret rotation + node rollout = within 4 hours; full post-rotation audit + KMS rewrap = within 24 hours. agree?
dave-plateng: agree. I’ll also run an RBAC scan to find any roles granting broad access to `svc-ci-build` and open a remediation ticket if needed.
anna-devsec: owner assignments: ben-ops = SA key revocation (complete by +2h), claire-sre = Vault secret rotation and node rollout (+4h), dave-plateng = RBAC audit and KMS rewrap coordination (+24h). I’ll own post-incident notes and the gist takedown.
ben-ops: update — I revoked two keys and posted their IDs: KEY_ID:a1b2c3 and KEY_ID:d4e5f6. Buildkite env vars removed. :lock:
claire-sre: Vault secret rotated and written to `secret/data/registry/ci` with new value. wrote via CI-role using transit. rolling restart started for the daemonset; progress ~30%.
rotation-bot: scheduled rotation created: rot-1842004321-registry-sa-sweep (owner: claire-sre)
anna-devsec: please add a follow-up to run `vault audit enable` checks and ensure audit devices are capturing read/write for that path. if audit_device missing we need to enable it.
audits-bot: vault-audit-check: enabled= true for main cluster, last-rotate-check= 2026-03-19T14:02:00Z
claire-sre: rollout finished, 0/0 older pods remain. registry pulls in prod now use new token. verified image pull logs show new service account user agent.
dave-plateng: RBAC scan results: no other principals with SA impersonation enabled for svc-ci-build. opened ticket PLAT-984 to track tightening legacy roles.
anna-devsec: TL;DR — leaked SA JSON in gist -> immediate revocation, Vault secret rotate, nodes rolled, audit exports running, RBAC review in flight. Owners listed above. Closing here once audits.csv posted and PLAT-984 is linked to the incident doc.
ben-ops: thanks everyone. marking incident resolved in Slack after audits CSV validated.
